sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Testing for matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) protein (CPT code 83516, CPT code 83520), lactoferrin (CPT code 83520) or immunoglobulin E (IgE) (CPT code 82785) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following: – Blepharitis – Discoid lupus erythematosus – Dry eye syndrome – Epiphora – Keratoconjunctivitis – Meibomian gland dysfunction – Sicca syndrome – Visual discomfort
